storyTitle: As Insurance Agent, I want to perform new policy creation through a guided wizard to achieve error-free submissions with minimal steps

functional.title: Verify wizard launches successfully and displays first step with relevant fields for selected line of business
preconditions: Insurance Agent user is authenticated and logged into the application
Agent has 'Policy Creation' permission assigned to their role
At least one active line of business (e.g., 'Personal Auto') and product type (e.g., 'Standard Auto') exist in the system
Agent is on the main dashboard or policy management page

steps.action: Click the 'Create New Policy' button on the policy management page
steps.expectedResult: Policy creation wizard opens and displays the first step (e.g., 'Select Line of Business & Product Type') with a clear heading and instructions

steps.action: Select 'Personal Auto' from the 'Line of Business' dropdown
steps.expectedResult: The dropdown accepts the selection and the 'Product Type' dropdown is filtered to show only product types relevant to Personal Auto (e.g., 'Standard Auto', 'Preferred Auto')

steps.action: Select 'Standard Auto' from the 'Product Type' dropdown
steps.expectedResult: The wizard dynamically updates to confirm the selection. Only fields relevant to Personal Auto - Standard Auto are queued for subsequent steps (e.g., Vehicle Information, Driver Information, Auto Coverage Options)

steps.action: Click the 'Next' button to proceed to Step 2
steps.expectedResult: Wizard advances to Step 2 which displays only the fields relevant to the selected line of business and product type. Irrelevant fields (e.g., property-related fields like 'Dwelling Type') are not shown

steps.action: Verify the fields displayed on Step 2 match the Personal Auto - Standard Auto configuration
steps.expectedResult: Step 2 shows fields such as 'Vehicle Year', 'Vehicle Make', 'Vehicle Model', 'VIN', and 'Usage Type' — all specific to auto insurance policy creation

postconditions: Wizard is on Step 2 with only Personal Auto relevant fields displayed
No data has been persisted to the database yet as the wizard is still in progress
User session remains active and authenticated

functional.title: Verify progress indicator accurately reflects current step, completed steps, and remaining steps with estimated time
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and has launched the policy creation wizard
Line of business 'Homeowners' and product type 'Standard Homeowners' have been selected
The wizard configuration for this product has 5 steps total

steps.action: Observe the progress indicator at the top of the wizard on Step 1
steps.expectedResult: Progress indicator shows Step 1 as the current step (highlighted/active), Steps 2-5 as remaining steps (greyed out or outlined), and displays an estimated time to completion (e.g., 'Estimated time: 8 minutes')

steps.action: Complete all required fields on Step 1 and click 'Next' to advance to Step 2
steps.expectedResult: Progress indicator updates: Step 1 is now marked as completed (e.g., green checkmark), Step 2 is highlighted as the current step, Steps 3-5 remain as remaining steps. Estimated time updates (e.g., 'Estimated time: 6 minutes')

steps.action: Complete all required fields on Step 2 and click 'Next' to advance to Step 3
steps.expectedResult: Progress indicator updates: Steps 1 and 2 are marked as completed with checkmarks, Step 3 is highlighted as current, Steps 4-5 are remaining. Estimated time updates accordingly

steps.action: Click the 'Back' button to return to Step 2
steps.expectedResult: Wizard navigates back to Step 2. Progress indicator shows Step 2 as current again, Step 1 remains completed, Steps 3-5 show as remaining. Previously entered data on Step 2 is preserved

steps.action: Click 'Next' again to return to Step 3 and continue through Steps 3, 4, and 5 completing all required fields
steps.expectedResult: At each step, the progress indicator correctly reflects the current step, all previously completed steps retain their completed status, and the estimated time decreases as the agent progresses

steps.action: On the final step (Step 5), observe the progress indicator before submission
steps.expectedResult: Steps 1-4 are all marked as completed, Step 5 is highlighted as the current/final step, estimated time shows '~1 minute' or similar, and a 'Submit' or 'Create Policy' button is visible

postconditions: Progress indicator has accurately tracked all 5 steps throughout the wizard flow
All step labels are visible and correctly named in the progress indicator
Estimated time was displayed and updated at each step transition

functional.title: Verify smart defaults pre-populate agent code, effective date, and standard coverage options
preconditions: Insurance Agent 'John Smith' with agent code 'AGT-12345' is authenticated and logged in
Today's date is 2025-01-15
Standard coverage options for 'Personal Auto - Standard Auto' are configured in the system (e.g., Liability: $100K/$300K, Collision Deductible: $500, Comprehensive Deductible: $500)
Agent has launched the policy creation wizard and selected 'Personal Auto' line of business and 'Standard Auto' product type

steps.action: Navigate to the step in the wizard that contains the 'Agent Code' field
steps.expectedResult: The 'Agent Code' field is pre-populated with 'AGT-12345' matching the logged-in agent's code. The field is either read-only or editable with the default value filled in

steps.action: Navigate to the step containing the 'Policy Effective Date' field
steps.expectedResult: The 'Policy Effective Date' field is pre-populated with today's date '01/15/2025' or the next business day. The agent can modify this date if needed

steps.action: Navigate to the step containing coverage options
steps.expectedResult: Standard coverage options are pre-populated: Bodily Injury Liability shows '$100,000/$300,000', Property Damage Liability shows '$50,000', Collision Deductible shows '$500', Comprehensive Deductible shows '$500'. All values match the configured defaults for Standard Auto

steps.action: Count the total number of fields in the wizard and identify which ones are pre-populated vs. which require manual entry
steps.expectedResult: At least 40% of the total fields across all wizard steps are pre-populated with smart defaults, reducing the agent's manual data entry effort significantly

steps.action: Modify the pre-populated 'Policy Effective Date' from '01/15/2025' to '02/01/2025'
steps.expectedResult: The system accepts the modified date. The 'Policy Expiration Date' (if present) automatically recalculates based on the new effective date (e.g., updates to '02/01/2026' for a 12-month term)

steps.action: Modify the Collision Deductible from the default '$500' to '$1,000'
steps.expectedResult: The system accepts the modified deductible value. Any premium estimate or related fields update accordingly to reflect the higher deductible

postconditions: Agent code, effective date, and standard coverage options were all pre-populated with correct smart defaults
Modified values are retained and reflected in the wizard state
Manual entry reduction of at least 40% is achieved through smart defaults

functional.title: Verify complete end-to-end policy creation wizard submission and data persistence
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated with valid credentials and has 'Policy Creation' permission
All reference data (lines of business, product types, coverage options, rating tables) are loaded in the system
Agent is on the policy management page
Database is accessible and writable

steps.action: Click 'Create New Policy' and select 'Personal Auto' line of business and 'Standard Auto' product type, then click 'Next'
steps.expectedResult: Wizard advances to the policyholder information step with relevant fields displayed

steps.action: Enter policyholder details: First Name: 'Jane', Last Name: 'Doe', Date of Birth: '03/15/1985', Address: '123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701', Phone: '(217) 555-0100', Email: 'jane.doe@email.com'. Click 'Next'
steps.expectedResult: All fields pass validation. Wizard advances to the vehicle/risk information step

steps.action: Enter vehicle details: Year: '2023', Make: 'Toyota', Model: 'Camry', VIN: '4T1BF1FK5CU123456', Usage: 'Commute'. Click 'Next'
steps.expectedResult: Vehicle information is validated (VIN format check passes). Wizard advances to the coverage selection step

steps.action: Review pre-populated coverage defaults and accept them as-is. Click 'Next'
steps.expectedResult: Coverage selections are confirmed. Wizard advances to the review/summary step

steps.action: Review the complete policy summary on the final step, verifying all entered and pre-populated data is displayed correctly
steps.expectedResult: Summary page displays all data: policyholder info, vehicle info, coverage selections, agent code, effective date, and estimated premium. All values match what was entered or defaulted

steps.action: Click the 'Submit Policy' button on the review/summary step
steps.expectedResult: System processes the submission. A success confirmation message appears (e.g., 'Policy PL-2025-00001 has been created successfully'). A unique policy number is generated and displayed

steps.action: Navigate to the policy search page and search for the newly created policy number 'PL-2025-00001'
steps.expectedResult: The policy is found in the search results. Clicking on it displays all the details that were entered during the wizard, confirming data persistence to the database

steps.action: Verify the policy status in the system
steps.expectedResult: The policy status shows as 'Active' or 'Pending Review' depending on business rules. All fields including agent code, effective date, policyholder info, vehicle info, and coverages are correctly stored

postconditions: New policy record is persisted in the application database with a unique policy number
All entered and defaulted data is accurately stored and retrievable
Agent is redirected to the policy confirmation or policy detail page
Audit trail records the policy creation event with agent ID and timestamp

functional.title: Verify wizard displays different relevant fields when switching between different lines of business
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and on the policy creation wizard
System has at least two different lines of business configured: 'Personal Auto' and 'Homeowners'
Each line of business has distinct field configurations in the system

steps.action: On Step 1 of the wizard, select 'Personal Auto' from the Line of Business dropdown and 'Standard Auto' from the Product Type dropdown. Note the steps and fields shown in the progress indicator
steps.expectedResult: Wizard configures steps relevant to Personal Auto: steps may include Policyholder Info, Vehicle Information, Driver Information, Coverage Selection, Review. Auto-specific fields like VIN, Vehicle Make/Model, Driver License Number are expected

steps.action: Click 'Back' or restart the wizard. Select 'Homeowners' from the Line of Business dropdown and 'Standard Homeowners' from the Product Type dropdown
steps.expectedResult: Wizard reconfigures to show steps relevant to Homeowners: steps may include Policyholder Info, Property Information, Dwelling Details, Coverage Selection, Review. Property-specific fields like 'Dwelling Type', 'Year Built', 'Square Footage', 'Roof Type' are displayed instead of auto fields

steps.action: Advance through the Homeowners wizard steps and verify that no auto-specific fields appear
steps.expectedResult: No fields related to vehicles (VIN, Make, Model) or drivers (License Number, Driving Record) appear anywhere in the Homeowners wizard flow

steps.action: Verify that coverage options on the coverage step are specific to Homeowners
steps.expectedResult: Coverage options show Homeowners-specific coverages such as 'Dwelling Coverage', 'Personal Property Coverage', 'Liability Coverage', 'Loss of Use' rather than auto coverages like 'Collision' or 'Comprehensive'

postconditions: Wizard correctly adapts field display based on the selected line of business
No cross-contamination of fields between different lines of business
Progress indicator step count and labels adjust per line of business

functional.title: Verify wizard navigation - Back button preserves previously entered data
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and has started the policy creation wizard
Line of business 'Personal Auto' and product type 'Standard Auto' are selected
Agent has advanced to Step 3 of the wizard with data entered on Steps 1 and 2

steps.action: On Step 3 (e.g., Coverage Selection), note the current field values. Click the 'Back' button
steps.expectedResult: Wizard navigates back to Step 2. All previously entered data on Step 2 (e.g., Vehicle Year: '2023', Make: 'Toyota', Model: 'Camry') is preserved and displayed in the fields

steps.action: Click the 'Back' button again to return to Step 1
steps.expectedResult: Wizard navigates back to Step 1. All previously entered data on Step 1 (e.g., policyholder name, address) is preserved and displayed

steps.action: Click 'Next' to advance back to Step 2
steps.expectedResult: Step 2 displays with all previously entered data intact. No data loss occurred during backward navigation

steps.action: Click 'Next' again to advance to Step 3
steps.expectedResult: Step 3 displays with all previously entered or selected data intact. The entire wizard state is preserved through forward and backward navigation

postconditions: All data entered across all wizard steps is preserved after multiple back-and-forth navigations
No data loss or field reset occurred during navigation
Progress indicator correctly reflects the current step after navigation

functional.title: Verify wizard step validation prevents advancing with missing required fields
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and on Step 2 of the policy creation wizard
Step 2 contains required fields such as 'First Name', 'Last Name', and 'Date of Birth'
No data has been entered on Step 2 yet

steps.action: Leave all required fields on Step 2 blank and click the 'Next' button
steps.expectedResult: The wizard does not advance to Step 3. Validation error messages appear next to each required field (e.g., 'First Name is required', 'Last Name is required', 'Date of Birth is required'). Error messages are displayed in red text

steps.action: Enter 'Jane' in the 'First Name' field but leave 'Last Name' and 'Date of Birth' blank. Click 'Next'
steps.expectedResult: The wizard still does not advance. Validation error clears for 'First Name' but remains for 'Last Name' and 'Date of Birth'

steps.action: Fill in all remaining required fields: Last Name: 'Doe', Date of Birth: '03/15/1985'. Click 'Next'
steps.expectedResult: All validation errors clear. The wizard successfully advances to Step 3

steps.action: Verify the progress indicator updates after successful advancement
steps.expectedResult: Step 2 is marked as completed in the progress indicator and Step 3 is highlighted as the current step

postconditions: Wizard enforces required field validation at each step before allowing progression
Validation error messages are clear and specific to each field
Successfully validated steps are marked as completed in the progress indicator

functional.title: Verify system correctly processes and returns expected results for policy creation (Scenario 4 - successful processing)
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated with valid credentials
All wizard steps have been completed with valid data
Agent is on the review/summary step of the wizard
Backend API and database services are operational

steps.action: Review all policy details on the summary step and confirm accuracy of policyholder information, risk details, and coverage selections
steps.expectedResult: All data displayed on the summary matches what was entered in previous steps. No discrepancies are found

steps.action: Click the 'Submit Policy' button
steps.expectedResult: System processes the policy creation request. A loading indicator or spinner is displayed during processing

steps.action: Wait for the system to complete processing
steps.expectedResult: System returns a success response. Confirmation screen displays with the generated policy number, effective date, and a summary of the created policy. A success message such as 'Policy created successfully' is shown

steps.action: Verify the policy details via the API or by navigating to the policy detail page
steps.expectedResult: The API returns the correct policy data with all fields matching the submitted values. Policy status is set appropriately (e.g., 'Active' or 'Bound'). All coverage amounts, deductibles, and limits are correctly stored

steps.action: Check that the system response time for the submission was within acceptable SLA limits
steps.expectedResult: Policy creation completes within the defined SLA (e.g., under 5 seconds). No timeout or performance degradation is observed

postconditions: Policy is successfully created and persisted in the database with correct data
System returned expected results including policy number and confirmation
Response time met SLA requirements
Audit log entry created for the policy creation event

functional.title: Verify system handles operation correctly and returns expected results (Scenario 5 - retrieval after creation)
preconditions: A policy has been successfully created through the wizard in a previous test
The policy number (e.g., 'PL-2025-00001') is known
Insurance Agent is authenticated and on the policy management page
Database contains the persisted policy record

steps.action: Navigate to the policy search or lookup page
steps.expectedResult: Policy search page loads with search fields available (policy number, policyholder name, etc.)

steps.action: Enter the policy number 'PL-2025-00001' in the search field and click 'Search'
steps.expectedResult: System retrieves and displays the policy in the search results list with key details (policy number, policyholder name, status, effective date)

steps.action: Click on the policy record to open the full policy detail view
steps.expectedResult: Policy detail page loads displaying all information: policyholder details, risk/vehicle information, coverage selections, agent code, effective date, expiration date, and premium amount. All values match what was submitted through the wizard

steps.action: Verify data integrity by comparing each field value against the original wizard submission
steps.expectedResult: Every field value matches exactly: names, dates, addresses, coverage amounts, deductibles, agent code, and all other data points are consistent with the original submission

postconditions: Policy data is correctly retrieved from the database and displayed
Data integrity is confirmed — no data corruption or loss during persistence
System handles the retrieval operation within acceptable response times

functional.title: Verify wizard can be saved as draft and resumed later
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and has started the policy creation wizard
Agent has completed Steps 1 and 2 with valid data and is currently on Step 3
System supports save-as-draft functionality

steps.action: Click the 'Save as Draft' or 'Save & Exit' button on Step 3 of the wizard
steps.expectedResult: System saves the current wizard state including all entered data from Steps 1-3. A confirmation message appears (e.g., 'Draft saved successfully'). Agent is redirected to the policy management page or dashboard

steps.action: Log out of the application and log back in as the same agent
steps.expectedResult: Agent successfully logs back in and is on the dashboard

steps.action: Navigate to 'Drafts' or 'In-Progress Policies' section and locate the saved draft
steps.expectedResult: The saved draft appears in the list with identifying information (e.g., policyholder name, date saved, line of business)

steps.action: Click on the draft to resume the wizard
steps.expectedResult: Wizard reopens at Step 3 (where it was saved). All data from Steps 1 and 2 is preserved and accessible via the Back button. Step 3 data entered before saving is also preserved

postconditions: Draft policy data is persisted in the database and retrievable across sessions
Wizard resumes at the correct step with all previously entered data intact
Progress indicator correctly reflects the resumed state

functional.title: Verify product type dropdown filters based on selected line of business
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and on Step 1 of the policy creation wizard

System has multiple lines of business configured: 'Personal Auto' (with products: Standard Auto, Preferred Auto), 'Homeowners' (with products: Standard Homeowners, Premium Homeowners), 'Commercial Auto' (with products: Fleet, Non-Fleet)

steps.action: Click on the 'Line of Business' dropdown and select 'Personal Auto'
steps.expectedResult: The 'Product Type' dropdown is enabled and populated with only 'Standard Auto' and 'Preferred Auto'. No Homeowners or Commercial products appear

steps.action: Change the 'Line of Business' selection to 'Homeowners'
steps.expectedResult: The 'Product Type' dropdown refreshes and now shows only 'Standard Homeowners' and 'Premium Homeowners'. Previous auto products are no longer listed

steps.action: Change the 'Line of Business' selection to 'Commercial Auto'
steps.expectedResult: The 'Product Type' dropdown refreshes and now shows only 'Fleet' and 'Non-Fleet'. No personal auto or homeowners products appear

steps.action: Select 'Fleet' from the Product Type dropdown and click 'Next'
steps.expectedResult: Wizard advances to Step 2 with fields specific to Commercial Auto - Fleet policies

postconditions: Product type dropdown correctly filters based on the selected line of business each time
No cross-line-of-business product types are ever displayed
Wizard steps and fields adapt to the final selection

functional.title: Verify the review/summary step displays all data from all previous steps accurately
preconditions: Insurance Agent has completed all wizard steps with the following data: Line of Business: Personal Auto, Product: Standard Auto, Policyholder: Jane Doe, DOB: 03/15/1985, Vehicle: 2023 Toyota Camry, Agent Code: AGT-12345, Effective Date: 01/15/2025
Agent is on the final review/summary step of the wizard

steps.action: Review the 'Line of Business & Product' section on the summary page
steps.expectedResult: Displays 'Personal Auto - Standard Auto' correctly

steps.action: Review the 'Policyholder Information' section
steps.expectedResult: Displays First Name: 'Jane', Last Name: 'Doe', Date of Birth: '03/15/1985', and all other entered policyholder details accurately

steps.action: Review the 'Vehicle Information' section
steps.expectedResult: Displays Year: '2023', Make: 'Toyota', Model: 'Camry', VIN: '4T1BF1FK5CU123456', Usage: 'Commute'

steps.action: Review the 'Coverage Options' section
steps.expectedResult: Displays all selected coverage options with correct limits and deductibles matching what was selected or defaulted

steps.action: Review the 'Agent & Policy Details' section
steps.expectedResult: Displays Agent Code: 'AGT-12345', Effective Date: '01/15/2025', Policy Term, and any calculated premium estimate

steps.action: Click 'Edit' or the step indicator for Step 2 (Policyholder Info) to go back and make a change
steps.expectedResult: Wizard navigates back to Step 2 allowing the agent to edit policyholder information. After editing and navigating back to the summary, the updated data is reflected

postconditions: Summary step accurately reflects all data from every wizard step
Agent can navigate back to any step from the summary to make edits
Edited data is correctly updated on the summary upon return

functional.title: Verify smart defaults reduce manual entry by at least 40%
preconditions: Insurance Agent 'AGT-12345' is authenticated
System has smart defaults configured for 'Personal Auto - Standard Auto'
A complete list of all wizard fields for this product type is documented for comparison

steps.action: Launch the policy creation wizard and select 'Personal Auto' - 'Standard Auto'
steps.expectedResult: Wizard initializes with the first step displayed

steps.action: Navigate through all wizard steps WITHOUT entering any data, counting the total number of input fields across all steps
steps.expectedResult: Total field count is documented (e.g., 25 total fields across all steps)

steps.action: Restart the wizard with the same selections and count the number of fields that are pre-populated with smart defaults (agent code, effective date, standard coverages, default deductibles, policy term, etc.)
steps.expectedResult: Pre-populated field count is documented (e.g., 12 out of 25 fields are pre-populated). This includes at minimum: Agent Code, Effective Date, Expiration Date, standard coverage limits, and default deductibles

steps.action: Calculate the percentage of pre-populated fields: (pre-populated fields / total fields) × 100
steps.expectedResult: The percentage of pre-populated fields is at least 40% (e.g., 12/25 = 48%). The 40% reduction threshold specified in the acceptance criteria is met or exceeded

postconditions: Smart defaults achieve at least 40% reduction in manual data entry
All pre-populated values are accurate and appropriate for the selected product type
Agent can override any pre-populated default value if needed

functional.title: Verify wizard handles authenticated agent session and security requirements
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated with valid credentials
Agent has the required 'Policy Creation' role/permission
Application enforces authentication on all policy creation endpoints

steps.action: Navigate to the policy creation wizard while authenticated
steps.expectedResult: Wizard loads successfully. Agent's identity is recognized (agent code pre-populated)

steps.action: Inspect the network requests (via browser developer tools) during wizard interaction
steps.expectedResult: All API calls include proper authentication tokens/headers. No sensitive data is transmitted in URL parameters. HTTPS is used for all requests

steps.action: Enter data with potential XSS content in a text field, e.g., First Name: '<script>alert(1)</script>'
steps.expectedResult: System sanitizes the input. The script tag is either rejected with a validation error or stored as escaped text. No script execution occurs

steps.action: Submit the policy and verify the stored data
steps.expectedResult: If the input was accepted, it is stored as sanitized/escaped text. If rejected, a clear validation error was shown. Input validation is enforced on both client and server side

postconditions: Authentication is enforced throughout the wizard flow
Input validation prevents injection attacks
All data transmission uses secure protocols

negative.title: Verify wizard prevents submission with all required fields empty
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and on the policy creation wizard
Line of business and product type have been selected on Step 1
Agent is on a step with multiple required fields (e.g., Policyholder Information)

steps.action: Leave all fields on the current step completely empty (do not enter any data)
steps.expectedResult: Fields remain blank with no default values (except smart-defaulted fields)

steps.action: Click the 'Next' button to attempt to advance to the next step
steps.expectedResult: Wizard does NOT advance. Validation error messages appear for each required field (e.g., 'First Name is required', 'Last Name is required', 'Date of Birth is required'). Errors are displayed in red near the respective fields

steps.action: Attempt to click directly on a later step in the progress indicator to skip ahead
steps.expectedResult: System prevents skipping to a later step when the current step has validation errors. Either the click is ignored or a message indicates the current step must be completed first

postconditions: No data is saved or persisted when required fields are empty
Wizard remains on the current step with validation errors displayed
No partial or incomplete policy record is created in the database

negative.title: Verify wizard rejects invalid date format for effective date
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and on the wizard step containing the 'Policy Effective Date' field
The effective date field has been cleared of its smart default value

steps.action: Clear the 'Policy Effective Date' field and enter '13/32/2025' (invalid month and day)
steps.expectedResult: System displays a validation error: 'Please enter a valid date in MM/DD/YYYY format' or similar. The field is highlighted in red

steps.action: Clear the field and enter 'abcd-ef-gh' (non-date text)
steps.expectedResult: System displays a validation error indicating invalid date format. The field does not accept non-numeric characters in the date field, or rejects the input upon validation

steps.action: Clear the field and enter '02/30/2025' (February 30th - impossible date)
steps.expectedResult: System displays a validation error: 'Invalid date' or 'February does not have 30 days'. The wizard does not advance

steps.action: Clear the field and enter '01/15/2020' (a date in the past)
steps.expectedResult: System displays a validation error: 'Effective date cannot be in the past' or similar. The wizard does not advance

steps.action: Click 'Next' with the invalid date still in the field
steps.expectedResult: Wizard does not advance. Validation error remains visible next to the date field

postconditions: No policy is created with an invalid effective date
All invalid date formats are rejected with clear error messages
Wizard remains on the current step until a valid date is provided

negative.title: Verify wizard rejects special characters and SQL injection in text fields
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and on the policyholder information step of the wizard
Required text fields such as 'First Name', 'Last Name', and 'Address' are visible

steps.action: Enter SQL injection string in the 'First Name' field: "'; DROP TABLE policies; --"
steps.expectedResult: System either rejects the input with a validation error ('Invalid characters in First Name') or sanitizes the input. No database operation is executed. The application does not crash or display a database error

steps.action: Enter XSS attack string in the 'Last Name' field: '<script>alert("XSS")</script>'
steps.expectedResult: System either rejects the input with a validation error or sanitizes/escapes the HTML tags. No JavaScript execution occurs. The field displays the text as plain text if accepted

steps.action: Enter excessive special characters in the 'Address' field: '!@#$%^&*()_+={}[]|\:";<>?,./~`'
steps.expectedResult: System validates the input. Common address characters (., #, -) may be accepted, but unusual special characters trigger a validation warning or are stripped

steps.action: Click 'Next' to attempt to advance
steps.expectedResult: If invalid inputs were flagged, the wizard does not advance and shows appropriate validation errors. If inputs were sanitized and accepted, the wizard advances with sanitized data

postconditions: No SQL injection or XSS attack is successful
Database integrity is maintained — no tables dropped or data corrupted
Application remains stable and functional after injection attempts

negative.title: Verify unauthenticated user cannot access the policy creation wizard
preconditions: User is NOT logged into the application (no active session)
The direct URL to the policy creation wizard is known (e.g., '/policies/create/wizard')

steps.action: Open a new browser window/tab and navigate directly to the policy creation wizard URL without logging in
steps.expectedResult: System redirects the user to the login page. The policy creation wizard is NOT displayed. An error message may appear: 'Please log in to access this feature'

steps.action: Attempt to call the policy creation API endpoint directly (e.g., POST /api/policies/create) without an authentication token using a tool like Postman
steps.expectedResult: API returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized response. No policy data is created. Response body contains an error message such as 'Authentication required'

steps.action: Attempt to access the wizard URL with an expired session token
steps.expectedResult: System detects the expired session and redirects to the login page. A message such as 'Your session has expired. Please log in again' is displayed

postconditions: Unauthenticated users cannot access any part of the policy creation wizard
No policy data is created or exposed to unauthenticated users
All unauthorized access attempts are logged for security auditing

negative.title: Verify user without Policy Creation permission cannot access the wizard
preconditions: A user with role 'Read-Only Agent' or 'Claims Adjuster' (without 'Policy Creation' permission) is authenticated
The user is on the main dashboard or policy management page

steps.action: Look for the 'Create New Policy' button on the policy management page
steps.expectedResult: The 'Create New Policy' button is either not visible or is disabled/greyed out for users without Policy Creation permission

steps.action: Attempt to navigate directly to the policy creation wizard URL (e.g., '/policies/create/wizard')

steps.expectedResult: API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden response. Response body contains: 'Insufficient permissions to create policies'

postconditions: Users without Policy Creation permission cannot access the wizard through any method
No policy data is created by unauthorized users
Permission denial is logged in the audit trail

negative.title: Verify wizard handles network failure during policy submission gracefully
preconditions: Insurance Agent has completed all wizard steps with valid data
Agent is on the review/summary step ready to submit
Browser developer tools are open to simulate network conditions

steps.action: Using browser developer tools, set the network to 'Offline' mode to simulate a network disconnection
steps.expectedResult: Network is disconnected. No outgoing requests can reach the server

steps.action: Click the 'Submit Policy' button while offline
steps.expectedResult: System attempts to submit but fails. A user-friendly error message is displayed: 'Unable to submit policy. Please check your network connection and try again.' The wizard does NOT close or lose the entered data

steps.action: Re-enable the network connection (set to 'Online' in developer tools)
steps.expectedResult: Network connectivity is restored

steps.action: Click the 'Submit Policy' button again (or a 'Retry' button if available)
steps.expectedResult: System successfully submits the policy. Confirmation message appears with the generated policy number. All data is correctly persisted

steps.action: Verify no duplicate policy was created from the failed attempt
steps.expectedResult: Only one policy record exists in the database. The failed submission did not create a partial or duplicate record

postconditions: Network failure is handled gracefully with a clear error message
No data loss occurs during network failure — wizard state is preserved
No duplicate or partial policy records are created
Successful retry creates exactly one policy record

negative.title: Verify wizard rejects excessively long input in text fields
preconditions: Insurance Agent is authenticated and on the policyholder information step
Text fields such as 'First Name', 'Last Name', and 'Address' are visible

steps.action: Enter a string of 500 characters in the 'First Name' field (e.g., 'A' repeated 500 times)

userStoryObject.title: As Insurance Agent, I want to perform new policy creation through a guided wizard to achieve error-free submissions with minimal steps
userStoryObject.description:
CONTEXT & BACKGROUND:
Policy creation involves many fields; a step-by-step wizard with smart defaults reduces cognitive load and prevents incomplete submissions.

CURRENT STATE:
Manual or incomplete process today.

DESIRED STATE:
System supports the capability end-to-end.

KEY FUNCTIONALITY:
• Implement core logic and validation
• Expose API and UI
• Handle errors and edge cases
• Ensure data persistence and retrieval

USER INTERACTION FLOW:
1. User accesses the feature
2. User performs the required action
3. System processes the request
4. System displays results or confirmation
5. User verifies the outcome

TECHNICAL CONSIDERATIONS:
• Data source: application database
• Security: authentication and input validation
• Performance: meet SLA requirements

OUT OF SCOPE:
• Advanced customization (future story)

SUCCESS METRICS:
